package.name: swiftnav_ros2_driver
package.description: Message-only stand-in for Swift Navigation's swiftnav_ros2_driver (github.com/robotian/swiftnav-ros2) in the simulator: just its Baseline message, copied verbatim, so dual_duro_heading and duro_sim build and run. The real package's sbp-to-ros driver needs libsbp (not packaged for Ubuntu) and a real Duro; in the sim, duro_sim publishes the Baseline topic instead. Don't put this next to the real driver in one workspace.
